prompt:
Create an ATL transformation module named `BibTeX2DocBook` that transforms a `BibTeXFile` into a `DocBook` model.

The main rule `Main` should build a single `DocBook` containing one `Book`, one `Article` titled “BibTeXML to DocBook” and four `Sect1` sections:

- “References List”: all `BibTeXEntry` instances as paragraphs, ordered by id, using a context helper `buildEntryPara()` on `BibTeXEntry` that concatenates id, type name, and available fields (title, authors, year, booktitle, school, journal, note, publisher, chapter).
- “Authors list”: distinct `Author` objects, sorted by author name, computed by helper `authorSet`. Rule `Author` creates a `Para` per distinct author.
- “Titles List”: distinct titled entries, sorted by title, computed by helper `titledEntrySet`, and using title paragraphs produced in rules.
- “Journals List”: distinct `Article` journals, sorted by journal, computed by helper `articleSet`, and using journal paragraphs produced in rules.

Define separate rules to generate paragraphs depending on whether a `BibTeXEntry` is titled or not, and for `Article` entries combine the presence/absence of title and journal:

- `UntitledEntry` for non-`TitledEntry` entries (one content paragraph using `buildEntryPara()`).
- `TitledEntry_Title_NoArticle` and `TitledEntry_NoTitle_NoArticle` for non-`Article` titled entries, controlled by membership in `titledEntrySet`, creating entry and/or title paragraphs.
- `Article_Title_Journal`, `Article_NoTitle_Journal`, `Article_Title_NoJournal`, `Article_NoTitle_NoJournal` for `Article` instances, combining membership in `titledEntrySet` and `articleSet` and creating entry, title, and/or journal `Para` elements accordingly.

Use `resolveTemp` where needed to reference previously created title and journal paragraphs from `Main`.

-- End of request.

module BibTeX2DocBook;
create OUT : DocBook from IN : BibTeX;

helper context BibTeX!BibTeXEntry def: buildEntryPara() : String =
	'[' + self.id + ']' + ' ' + self.oclType().name +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!TitledEntry) then
		' title = ' + self.title
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!AuthoredEntry) then
		' author = ' + self.authors->iterate(a; res : String = '' |
			res + if res = '' then '' else ' and ' endif + a.author)
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!DatedEntry) then
		' year = ' + self.year
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!BookTitledEntry) then
		' booktitle = ' + self.booktitle
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!ThesisEntry) then
		' school = ' + self.school
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!Article) then
		' journal = ' + self.journal
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!Unpublished) then
		' note = ' + self.note
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!Book) then
		' publisher = ' + self.publisher
	else
		''
	endif +
	if self.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!InBook) then
		' chapter = ' + self.chapter.toString()
	else
		''
	endif;

helper def: authorSet : Set(BibTeX!Author) =
	BibTeX!Author.allInstances()->select(e |
		BibTeX!Author.allInstances()->select(l | l.author = e.author)->first() = e
	)->asSet();

helper def: titledEntrySet : Set(BibTeX!TitledEntry) =
	BibTeX!TitledEntry.allInstances()->select(e |
		BibTeX!TitledEntry.allInstances()->select(l | l.title = e.title)->first() = e
	)->asSet();

helper def: articleSet : Set(BibTeX!Article) =
	BibTeX!Article.allInstances()->select(e |
		BibTeX!Article.allInstances()->select(l | l.journal = e.journal)->first() = e
	)->asSet();

rule Main {
	from
		bib : BibTeX!BibTeXFile
	to
		doc : DocBook!DocBook (
			books <- book
		),
		book : DocBook!Book (
			articles <- article
		),
		article : DocBook!Article (
			title <- 'BibTeXML to DocBook',
			sections_1 <- Sequence {se1, se2, se3, se4}
		),
		se1 : DocBook!Sect1 (
			title <- 'References List',
			paras <- BibTeX!BibTeXEntry.allInstances()->sortedBy(e | e.id)
		),
		se2 : DocBook!Sect1 (
			title <- 'Authors list',
			paras <- thisModule.authorSet->sortedBy(a | a.author)
		),
		se3 : DocBook!Sect1 (
			title <- 'Titles List',
			paras <- thisModule.titledEntrySet->sortedBy(e | e.title)->collect(e | thisModule.resolveTemp(e, 'p_title'))
		),
		se4 : DocBook!Sect1 (
			title <- 'Journals List',
			paras <- thisModule.articleSet->sortedBy(e | e.journal)->collect(e | thisModule.resolveTemp(e, 'p_journal'))
		)
}

rule Author {
	from
		a : BibTeX!Author (
			thisModule.authorSet->includes(a)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- a.author
		)
}

rule UntitledEntry {
	from
		e : BibTeX!BibTeXEntry (
			not e.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!TitledEntry)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.buildEntryPara()
		)
}

rule TitledEntry_Title_NoArticle {
	from
		e : BibTeX!TitledEntry (
			not e.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!Article) and thisModule.titledEntrySet->includes(e)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.buildEntryPara()
		),
		p_title : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.title
		)
}

rule TitledEntry_NoTitle_NoArticle {
	from
		e : BibTeX!TitledEntry (
			not e.oclIsKindOf(BibTeX!Article) and not thisModule.titledEntrySet->includes(e)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.buildEntryPara()
		)
}

rule Article_Title_Journal {
	from
		e : BibTeX!Article (
			thisModule.titledEntrySet->includes(e) and thisModule.articleSet->includes(e)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.buildEntryPara()
		),
		p_title : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.title
		),
		p_journal : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.journal
		)
}

rule Article_NoTitle_Journal {
	from
		e : BibTeX!Article (
			not thisModule.titledEntrySet->includes(e) and thisModule.articleSet->includes(e)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.buildEntryPara()
		),
		p_journal : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.journal
		)
}

rule Article_Title_NoJournal {
	from
		e : BibTeX!Article (
			thisModule.titledEntrySet->includes(e) and not thisModule.articleSet->includes(e)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.buildEntryPara()
		),
		p_title : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.title
		)
}

rule Article_NoTitle_NoJournal {
	from
		e : BibTeX!Article (
			not thisModule.titledEntrySet->includes(e) and not thisModule.articleSet->includes(e)
		)
	to
		p : DocBook!Para (
			content <- e.buildEntryPara()
		)
}
